title: Lab finds unknown chemical burning in soil and tree samples

tellings.quote: took them to the lab and some months later he said that the lab results indicated that the burning of the soil in the tree was caused by chemical products and that they were unknown.

plain: Soil and a tree at a site near Varginha, Brazil, where a strange craft is said to have come down in 1996, were burned by chemical products that a lab could not identify, according to results relayed by Carlos de Souza, a guest on an episode about the case. He says a researcher named Claudia Kovu took samples to the lab, and months later reported that "the burning of the soil in the tree was caused by chemical products and that they were unknown." De Souza passes it on from Kovu, also pointing to home-movie film shot on Super 8 cameras, as evidence that something out of the ordinary touched down there.
